# Methodological Overview

This document outlines the downstream statistical workflow for quantifying gene expression across target loci (*CUP1*, *CRS5*, *CTR1*, *SOD1*, and *HSP12*) in copper-stressed *Saccharomyces cerevisiae* isolates.

To manage locus-level constraints while preserving statistical accuracy, this pipeline bypasses full genome-wide differential expression models (e.g., `DESeq2` Wald tests) in favor of **linear regression modeling**, **zero-variance filtering**, **Principal Component Analysis (PCA)**, and **unsupervised hierarchical clustering (`pheatmap`)**.

## Key Technical & Methodological Safeguards:

- **Dimensionality Preservation:** Matrix subscript guards (`drop = FALSE`) are added across all subsetting steps to prevent 1D vector collapse when isolating single samples or genes.

- **Automated Variance Pre-Filtering:** Genes exhibiting zero variance across target strains (*SOD1*, *HSP12*, and *CTR1*) are dynamically detected and excluded prior to row scaling in `pheatmap` and unit-variance scaling in `prcomp(scale. = TRUE)` to prevent divide-by-zero errors.

- **Differentiator Analysis:** Dimensionality reduction and biplots prioritize high-variance loci (*CUP1* vs *CRS5*), isolating the primary genomic drivers of phenotypic growth under 10 mM $\text{CuSO}_4$ stress.

## Pipeline Implementation

### 1. Environment Setup & Dependency Loading

``` r
#| label: setup-dependencies
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(ggfortify)
  library(RColorBrewer)
  library(data.table)
})

# Ensure output directory exists for figure exports
if (!dir.exists("outputs")) {
  dir.create("outputs", recursive = TRUE)
}
```

### 2. File Path Configuration & Data Ingestion

``` r
#| label: data-ingestion
# 2. Define File Paths & Load Sample Metadata

# Define input files
count_files <- c(
  "data/counts/Y12_counts.txt",
  "data/counts/YJM1389_counts.txt",
  "data/counts/YPS128_counts.txt",
  "data/counts/YPS163_counts.txt"
)

# Paths for large matrix files 
cnv_path <- "data/matrices/genesMatrix_CopyNumber.tab"
pheno_path <- "data/matrices/pheno_35Conditions_NormalizedByYPD.txt"

# Load Phenotype Matrix
pheno <- read.table(pheno_path, header = TRUE, row.names = 1, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE)

# Load Genes (Copy Number) Matrix
genesMatrix <- read.table(cnv_path, header = TRUE, row.names = 1, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE)

# Build Count_matrix from individual files - Read files into a list
raw_counts_list <- lapply(count_files, function(x) {
  read.table(x, header = TRUE, row.names = 1, sep = "\t")
})

# Combine into one matrix
Count_matrix <- do.call(cbind, raw_counts_list)

# Mapping Based on input:
# File 1 (Y12) is ACK
# File 2 (YJM1389) is SACE_YCK
# File 3 (YPS128) is AKN
# File 4 (YPS163) is AVI
colnames(Count_matrix) <- c("ACK", "SACE_YCK", "AKN", "AVI")
```

### 3. Data Filtering, Subsetting & Master Dataset Merging

``` r
#| label: filtering-merging
# Define the master list of samples to keep
target_samples <- c("ACK", "SACE_YCK", "AKN", "AVI")

# Define the Gene Columns (Headers from genesMatrix)
gene_cols_long <- c(
  "X3978.YGR078C", 
  "X5010.YJR104C", 
  "X3259.YEL024W", 
  "X6910.YOL112W", 
  "X6999.YOR031W")

# Define the Phenotype Column
pheno_col <- "YPDCUSO410MM"

# Subset for our four samples and the copper column
clean_pheno <- pheno[target_samples,pheno_col, drop = FALSE]
colnames(clean_pheno) <- "Copper_Growth"

# Subset for four samples and five gene columns
clean_genes <- genesMatrix[target_samples,gene_cols_long]

# Rename columns to common names for clarity
# Assume order: YGR078C, YJR104C, YEL024W, YOL112W, YOR031W based on matrix reference
colnames(clean_genes) <- c("CUP1", "SOD1", "HSP12", "CTR1", "CRS5")

# Select the columns for samples
clean_counts <- Count_matrix[,target_samples, drop = FALSE]

# Filter rows for the specific gene IDs with subscript guard
short_ids <- c("YGR078C", "YJR104C", "YEL024W", "YOL112W", "YOR031W")
valid_ids <- intersect(short_ids, rownames(clean_counts))
clean_counts_subset <- clean_counts[valid_ids, , drop = FALSE]

# Transpose so that the samples are the rows
clean_counts_trans <- t(clean_counts_subset)

# Map gene names to raw count headers
gene_map <- c("YGR078C" = "CUP1", "YJR104C" = "SOD1", "YEL024W" = "HSP12", "YOL112W" = "CTR1", "YOR031W" = "CRS5")
mapped_names <- gene_map[colnames(clean_counts_trans)]
mapped_names[is.na(mapped_names)] <- colnames(clean_counts_trans)[is.na(mapped_names)] # Fallback
colnames(clean_counts_trans) <- paste0(mapped_names, "_raw")

# Merge Phenotype and Normalized Genes
master_df <- merge(clean_pheno, clean_genes, by = "row.names")

# Fix row names
rownames(master_df) <- master_df$Row.names
master_df$Row.names <- NULL

# Merge in the Raw counts
master_df <- merge(master_df, clean_counts_trans, by = "row.names")
rownames(master_df) <- master_df$Row.names
master_df$Row.names <- NULL

print("Master Dataframe:")
print(master_df)
```

### 4. Exploratory Visualization & Linear Regression Modeling

``` r
plot_data <- master_df[, c("Copper_Growth", "CUP1", "SOD1", "HSP12", "CTR1", "CRS5")]
plot_data$Sample <- rownames(plot_data)

# Convert to longer format
long_df <- pivot_longer(
  plot_data,
  cols = c("CUP1", "SOD1", "HSP12", "CTR1", "CRS5"),
  names_to = "Gene",
  values_to = "Expression"
)

# Scatter Plot: Gene Expression vs Growth Correlation
p1_GEvGC <- ggplot(long_df, aes(x = Expression, y = Copper_Growth)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Sample), size = 4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "grey", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Sample), vjust = -1, size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~Gene, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation: Gene Expression vs Copper Growth",
    y = "Copper Resistance (Growth)",
    x = "Normalized Gene Expression"
  )

print(p1_GEvGC)
ggsave("outputs/gene_expression_growth_correlation.png", plot = p1_GEvGC, width = 8, height = 6)

# Bar Plot: Gene Expression Profiles by Strain
p2_GEbS <- ggplot(long_df, aes(x = Sample, y = Expression, fill = Gene)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Gene Expression Profiles by Strain",
    y = "Normalized Copy Number / Expression",
    x = "Strain"
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")
print(p2_GEbS)
ggsave("outputs/expression_profiles_by_strain.png", plot = p2_GEbS, width = 7, height = 5)

# Bar Plot: Copper Resistance Ranking
p3_CRR <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = reorder(Sample, -Copper_Growth), y = Copper_Growth)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Copper Resistance by Strain",
    x = "Strain",
    y = "Growth in 10mM CuSO4"
  )
print(p3_CRR)
ggsave("outputs/copper_resistance_ranking.png", plot = p3_CRR, width = 6, height = 4)
```

### 5. Variance Filtering & Hierarchical Clustering

``` r
# Extract the numeric matrix for the 5 genes
heatmap_data <- t(master_df[, c("CUP1", "SOD1", "HSP12", "CTR1", "CRS5")])

# Check for NAs and replace them with 0 if found
heatmap_data[is.na(heatmap_data)] <- 0

# Check for Zero Variance Rows
gene_variances <- apply(heatmap_data, 1, var)
flat_genes <- gene_variances == 0

# If any exist, remove them
if (any(flat_genes)) {
  print(paste("Removing constant genes:", paste(names(which(flat_genes)), collapse = ", ")))
  heatmap_data <- heatmap_data[!flat_genes, , drop = FALSE]
}

annotation_col <- data.frame(Growth = master_df$Copper_Growth)
rownames(annotation_col) <- colnames(heatmap_data)

png("outputs/gene_expression_heatmap.png", width = 800, height = 600, res = 120)
pheatmap(
  heatmap_data,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  scale = "row",
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  main = "Gene Expression Heatmap",
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "darkred"))(50)
)
dev.off()
```

### 6. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) & Ordination

``` r
pca_data <- master_df[, c("CUP1", "SOD1", "HSP12", "CTR1", "CRS5")]

# Calculate variance for each column
variances <- apply(pca_data, 2, var)
constant_genes <- names(variances[variances == 0])

if (length(constant_genes) > 0) {
  print(paste("Removing constant genes:", paste(constant_genes, collapse = ", ")))
  pca_data_clean <- pca_data[, variances != 0, drop = FALSE]
} else {
  pca_data_clean <- pca_data
}

# Perform PCA
pca_result <- prcomp(pca_data_clean, scale. = TRUE)

# Format subtitle to handle gene exclusions
sub_text <- if (length(constant_genes) > 0) {
  paste("Excluded constant genes:", paste(constant_genes, collapse = ", "))
} else {
  "All 5 genes included"
}

p4_PCA <- autoplot(
  pca_result,
  data = master_df,
  colour = "Copper_Growth",
  size = 5,
  loadings = TRUE,
  loadings.label = TRUE,
  loadings.label.size = 5
) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red") +
  geom_text(aes(label = rownames(master_df)), vjust = -1) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of Copper Stress Strategies",
    subtitle = sub_text
  )
# Focal analysis on variable loci (CUP1, CRS5) after filtering constant genes
print(p4_PCA)
ggsave("outputs/pca_copper_stress_strategies.png", plot = p4_PCA, width = 7, height = 5)
```

### 7. Focal Differentiator Analysis (CUP1 vs CRS5)

``` r
p5_DA <- ggplot(master_df, aes(x = CUP1, y = CRS5)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Copper_Growth, size = Copper_Growth)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = rownames(master_df)), vjust = -1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "grey", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Differentiators: CUP1 vs CRS5",
    subtitle = "SOD1, HSP12, and CTR1 showed no variation between strains",
    x = "CUP1 Expression",
    y = "CRS5 Expression"
  )
print(p5_DA)
ggsave("outputs/differentiators_cup1_vs_crs5.png", plot = p5_DA, width = 7, height = 5)
```
